title: Atlas cognitive graph foundation
goal: Port the proven OTHRYS Atlas and Mnemosyne semantic foundations into the V2 OTHRYS OS house, then expose a fast derived knowledge-map workspace over canonical evidence.

work.problem: V2 has a governed Mnemosyne lifecycle but lacks the prior OTHRYS graph constitution and a usable Atlas-class knowledge operating surface.
out_of_scope: No new Titan or duplicate Greek subsystem
No model-driven autonomous mutation in this mission
risks: Atlas becomes a second architecture registry
Evidence and inference are visually conflated
Legacy Mnemosyne and Nine Muse semantics are duplicated or renamed
Pretty graph ships without deterministic provenance

laws: Atlas is a derived read model and workspace, never a Titan or authority.
Mnemosyne remains the knowledge authority; the Nine Muses remain semantic gates over one knowledge store.
Every evidence-basis node and edge carries explicit provenance.
A V2 evidence reference becomes VERIFIED only when its canonical result exists and passes.
The browser-facing graph is secret-free and authority-free.
Graph digest is deterministic when source evidence is unchanged.
Gravity and heat are cognitive signals, not truth or authority.
Inbox and Review are distinct lifecycle queues.
No automatic promotion, execution endpoint or gate relaxation is introduced.

slices.title: Atlas graph constitution and Mnemosyne semantic gates

tasks.title: Port typed nodes, edges, truth classes, provenance and deterministic IDs
Port the existing Nine Muses as semantic gates without new authorities
Verify vocabulary, provenance, authority and deterministic digest laws
Project systems, Titans, capabilities, models, integrations, knowledge, missions and Work from V2 evidence
Calculate gravity and heat without changing truth class
Keep Mnemosyne Inbox and Review queue semantics distinct
Verify evidence references cannot self-certify and inferred edges stay explicit
